claim: GIE's EPP Helm chart controls a --metrics-endpoint-auth CLI flag on the EPP container, and pre-PR#2061 this flag was set to false (auth disabled) only when Prometheus monitoring itself was disabled, conflating 'is Prometheus scraping configured' with 'is metrics auth required'.
stance_target: EPP/Prometheus metrics endpoint auth is on by default and how its toggle is wired

claim: PR #2061 rewires the same guard to key off a new nested value, monitoring.prometheus.auth.enabled, so that metrics-endpoint-auth can now be independently disabled even while Prometheus scraping is enabled.
stance_target: the metrics endpoint has a dedicated auth toggle separate from whether monitoring/Prometheus itself is turned on

claim: The bug fixed by PR #2061 implies that in the pre-fix chart, if a user enabled Prometheus monitoring without knowing about a separate auth sub-value, --metrics-endpoint-auth would remain at its underlying binary default (not forced to false by the chart), which the PR author treats as unwanted/incorrect behavior needing an explicit disable path -- consistent with the EPP binary defaulting metrics-endpoint-auth to true/on.
stance_target: EPP metrics endpoint auth is on by default absent explicit chart configuration to disable it
scope_conditions: inferred from Helm chart guard logic; PR title 'fix prometheus auth', fixes issue #2060
